title: GTA VI: Why the 13-year wait could be worth $8 billion
summary: After more than 13 years, Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches on November 19, and it's about a lot more than a video game. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian follows the money: why Take-Two is telling investors to expect $8 billion-plus in bookings this year but only about $109 million to $142 million in profit, how GTA Online's recurring spending became the real prize, and why Sony and Microsoft can cash in without making the game at all.

title: Josh Brown: Netflix Can Clear Wall Street’s 10.6% Growth Bar “Standing on Their Head”
